headlines.title: Rep. Lauren Boebert, conservative firebrand from Colorado, loses her race for re-election
headlines.description: The Colorado Republican changed to a more conservative district after a close re-election call in 2022. But this year’s blue tsunami has swept her out of office, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Alaskans opt to stick with ranked choice voting
headlines.description: Alaskans have decided to stick with ranked choice voting, rejecting a ballot measure that sought to repeal the system, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins the Alaska governor’s race
headlines.description: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins has won the Alaska governor’s race, NBC News projects, flipping control of the office from Republicans.

headlines.title: Republican Rep. Lauren Boebert will lose re-election, NBC News projects
headlines.description: NBC News projects Republican Rep. Lauren Boebert will lose her race for re-election to Congress in Colorado.

headlines.title: Protesters interrupt Rep. Jeffries at Democrats' 'What's Next' conference
headlines.description: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., was interrupted by protesters during Democrats' "What's Next" conference in Denver. The audience members appeared to question the leader's decisions on a possible impeachment of President Trump and other priorities as Democrats regain control of Congress.

headlines.title: Commerce Secretary Lutnick agrees to testify about Nvidia
headlines.description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed to testify before Congress over national security concerns regarding the expanding Nvidia scandal. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor details bipartisan concern and White House reaction.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Rubio urges conservatives to uplift their ideology, brushes off GOP midterm losses
headlines.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio on Friday downplayed Republicans’ devastating losses in the midterm elections, instead telling supporters, “Politics requires more than simply winning elections.”

headlines.title: Trump, Xi and Putin plan an unprecedented meeting on the sidelines of APEC, officials say
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will meet with the leaders of China and Russia on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzen, China’s tech hub, next week, an unprecedented gathering of the heads of the world’s biggest nuclear powers.

headlines.title: Trump administration delays Medicaid work requirements by six months
headlines.description: Work requirements were set to go into effect on Jan. 1 for many able-bodied adults who receive Medicaid, which could have left millions without health insurance.

headlines.title: Newly elected Senate Democrats in the spotlight: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Kristen Welker dives into the first big decision facing the class of incoming Democratic senators.

headlines.title: St. Patrick’s Day parade canceled in Florida thanks to state’s anti-DEI law
headlines.description: A new anti-DEI law championed by Florida Gov.
